scope: Individual slots for all 70 entries in the existing female champion regional register, including its separately labeled LoR-only Norra and non-romantic child/nonhumanoid entries. Other already-selected native/crossover women remain in their existing source-owned threads.
reading_rule: This is a planning index, never a replacement for full owners or current continuity.
integration_rule: Interleave encounters with the existing group's operations and regional movements. Never convert the season into an exclusive Kaze solo or a consecutive hookup tour. Other Sins retain their initiatives, matchups and screen time.
status_rule: Reserved individual slots are author-selected opportunities, not elapsed events. Adapt order inside regional movements to real choices/access. Track completed, pending, displaced or impossible rather than forcing a cameo. Do not promise all encounters inside a fixed episode count.
partner_rule: Romantic possibilities only for established adults with capacity, mutual interest and consent. Minors, childlike portrayals and unverified-adult versions are non-romantic; creature/spirit entries confer no body or sexual eligibility.
existing_meeting_rule: Before staging, read full owners and matching-branch relationship history; first meeting versus reunion is evidence-driven. Slots are selected story opportunities, not completed meetings, relationships, victories or pregnancies.
